purpose: Whole P4 bounded revision1: resolution-normalized center supervision; same scientific gates
architecture: Unmodified verified PilotInstanceNet from R16; ordinary early fusion replaces failed R18 dual-stream as the development baseline. This is not a repair or efficacy claim for R18.

training.selection: Same epoch for both arms: maximize mean of the two scene-macro monitor F1 values; strict improvement, earliest tied epoch retained.

final_evaluation: Export both selected checkpoints on all 160 already-exposed development frames each: FP32 heads, exact unchanged decoder, IoU matching, center confidence, class-agnostic COCO mask AP, boundary error, scene-level diagnostics. Independent cached-output verification. No held-out/test or calibration access.
integration: Use selected RGBD at representative existing development scenes to verify original-pixel and candidate linkage under an independently frozen bounded integration contract. Official pretrained grasp weights remain engineering-only with unknown training-scene exposure.
repair_policy: Preserve failed versions and evidence. Internal diagnosis/repair is authorized for P4, but frozen contracts must never be altered in place. No unlimited same-hypothesis trials; respect original two-adjustment/resource review rule.
completion: Only the complete P4 delivery and truthful usable/conditional/failure decision returns to user for next-part confirmation. Internal fit, epochs, scoring, and checks do not require renewed permission.
limitations: Single-seed development baseline, not P9 three-seed formal result
20 train scenes and 10 repeatedly exposed development scenes; no independent generalization claim
Both arms warm-start from R16 matched 1600-update checkpoints; cumulative training is reported
RGBD retains 6272 extra input-convolution parameters, so exact parameter equality is not claimed
Historical R18 zero-instance/AP result remains unchanged; P5/P8 not passed

repair.observed: v22 epoch5 RGBD monitor scene-macro F1=0.1318445165945166 < frozen 0.2; RGB=0.08785748734024597. Fit had passed. Preserve failure.
repair.hypothesis: At doubled linear resolution unchanged sigma3 reduces normalized positive center-target support fourfold. Change target Gaussian sigma to6, preserving R16 normalized width. This is a repair hypothesis, not a proved root cause of R18 or a result.
repair.changed: Only center target sigma3 to6; both arms; decoder, original labels, input images, split, optimizer and loss weights unchanged. New version, original frozen source untouched.
repair.cumulative_budget: Original 7000 total optimizer returns and 35000 forward intents/4h shared across versions. Prior800 research+new5600<=6400. Prior300 fit+new300<=600; additional200 engineering allowance uses original technical-recovery reserve. No new total budget.
